title.value: S WEET: Weakly Supervised Person Name Extraction for Fighting Human Trafficking
title.justification: The title reflects the focus on a weak supervision pipeline to aid in fighting human trafficking by extracting person names from advertisements.
title.quote: S WEET: Weakly Supervised Person Name Extraction for Fighting Human Trafficking

extractions.description: The paper proposes a weak supervision pipeline named S WEET to extract person names from noisy escort advertisements to combat human trafficking. It combines rule-matching strategies with large language models fine-tuned for specific datasets, effectively addressing the challenge of limited labeled data and outperforming existing methods.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on developing a method for extracting names from text to combat human trafficking. While it has social impact implications, it does not directly connect to climate or ecological sustainable development themes.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: In this work, we propose a weak supervision pipeline S WEET... to fight Trafficking for extracting person names from noisy escort advertisements.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not primarily focus on climate or ecological sustainability themes, but rather on a social issue of human trafficking.
primary_category.quote: Our method combines the simplicity of rulematching and the generalizability of large language models... to fight Trafficking for extracting person names from noisy escort advertisements.

primary_sub_category.justification: Since the primary category is unrelated to climate or ecological themes, there is no applicable sub-category.
primary_sub_category.quote: In this work, we propose a weak supervision pipeline S WEET... to fight Trafficking for extracting person names from noisy escort advertisements.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper addresses the social issue of human trafficking, focusing on the extraction of person names from advertisements to aid in combating this crime.
new_primary_category.quote: Based on discussions with domain experts, including criminologists, law enforcement, and other groups fighting trafficking, it was determined that extracting advertised names from the ads is particularly important.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The paper introduces a technology specifically designed to support efforts in identifying and combating human trafficking activities.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: To address these challenges, we propose a weakly supervised method S WEET... that efficiently extracts person names from escort ads and is independent of training labels.
